items.headline: Global-e Q2 2026 results show 44% GMV growth, 39% revenue growth, and margin expansion to ~21%; company raises full-year 2026 guidance
Global-e Q2 2026 earnings: GMV surpasses $2.0B, revenue reaches $299M, adjusted EBITDA margin ~20.9%
Global-e raises FY26 revenue guidance to $1.305B–$1.355B and Q3 2026 revenue outlook to ~$308.5M–$315.5M
Global-e board authorizes new $500M share repurchase program
Global-e closes acquisition of Passport in ~$350M cash-and-stock deal to expand cross-border logistics capabilities
Analysts raise Global-e price targets (Jefferies to $48, Goldman Sachs to $49) following Q2 results and guidance raise
Global-e Online (GLBE) given "Moderate Buy" consensus recommendation by brokerages
